# Complete Lean source appendix

All modules, including certificate data, in import order.

### `CubeChecker.lean`

```lean
import Mathlib.Data.List.Range
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Bitwise

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace CubeChecker

structure CubeEdge where
  mask : Nat
  a : Int
  b : Int
  c : Int
  deriving DecidableEq, Inhabited

inductive Action where
  | branch (edge : Nat) (children : List Nat)
  | leaf (packing : List (Nat × Nat))
  deriving DecidableEq, Inhabited

structure State where
  mask : Nat
  act : Action
  deriving DecidableEq, Inhabited

def vertices : List Nat := List.range 36

def weight (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  let ws : Array Nat := #[253,269,288,286,166,342,174,256,262,174,61,226,69,149,98,100,82,90]
  if i < 18 then ws[17-i]! else ws[i-18]!

def member (m i : Nat) : Bool := m.testBit i

def indices (m : Nat) : List Nat := vertices.filter (member m)

def weighted (m : Nat) : Nat := (indices m).foldl (fun s i => s + weight i) 0

def inside (x : Int) : Bool := decide (-18 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 18 ∧ x ≠ 0)

def index (x : Int) : Nat := if x < 0 then (x+18).toNat else (x+17).toNat

def cubeMask (e : CubeEdge) : Nat :=
  let xs := [e.a,e.b,e.c,e.a+e.b,e.a+e.c,e.b+e.c,e.a+e.b+e.c]
  xs.foldl (fun m x => m ||| (1 <<< index x)) 0

def validEdge (e : CubeEdge) : Bool :=
  let xs := [e.a,e.b,e.c,e.a+e.b,e.a+e.c,e.b+e.c,e.a+e.b+e.c]
  xs.all inside && (cubeMask e == e.mask)

def contained (a b : Nat) : Bool := (a &&& b) == a

def checkLeaf (edges : Array CubeEdge) (m : Nat) (pack : List (Nat × Nat)) : Bool :=
  pack.all (fun (e,k) => k > 0 && (e < edges.size && contained edges[e]!.mask m)) &&
  vertices.all (fun i =>
    pack.foldl (fun s (e,k) => s + if member edges[e]!.mask i then k else 0) 0 ≤ weight i) &&
  weighted m ≤ 4131 + (pack.map Prod.snd).sum

def checkState (edges : Array CubeEdge) (states : Array State) (j : Nat) : Bool :=
  if h : j < states.size then
    let st := states[j]
    st.mask < 2^36 &&
    match st.act with
    | .leaf pack => checkLeaf edges st.mask pack
    | .branch e children =>
      e < edges.size && edges[e]!.mask > 0 && contained edges[e]!.mask st.mask &&
      let is := indices edges[e]!.mask
      children.length == is.length &&
      (is.zip children).all (fun (i,c) =>
        c < j && states[c]!.mask == st.mask ^^^ (1 <<< i))
  else false

end CubeChecker
```

### `CubeEdgeBatch00.lean`

```lean
import CubeEdgesData
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega
set_option Elab.async false
set_option maxRecDepth 1000000
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
namespace CubeChecker
theorem edge_block0000 : (List.range 40).all (fun i => validEdge cubeEdges[i+0]!) = true := by decide +kernel
theorem edge_block0040 : (List.range 40).all (fun i => validEdge cubeEdges[i+40]!) = true := by decide +kernel
theorem edge_block0080 : (List.range 40).all (fun i => validEdge cubeEdges[i+80]!) = true := by decide +kernel
theorem edge_block0120 : (List.range 40).all (fun i => validEdge cubeEdges[i+120]!) = true := by decide +kernel
theorem edge_batch00 (i : Nat) (hlo : 0 ≤ i) (hhi : i < 160) : validEdge cubeEdges[i]! = true := by
  by_cases h0 : i < 40
  ·
    have hp : i-0 < 40 := by omega
    have hv := List.all_eq_true.mp edge_block0000 (i-0) (List.mem_range.mpr hp)
    have he : i-0+0 = i := by omega
    simpa only [he] using hv
  by_cases h40 : i < 80
  ·
    have hp : i-40 < 40 := by omega
    have hv := List.all_eq_true.mp edge_block0040 (i-40) (List.mem_range.mpr hp)
    have he : i-40+40 = i := by omega
    simpa only [he] using hv
  by_cases h80 : i < 120
  ·
    have hp : i-80 < 40 := by omega
    have hv := List.all_eq_true.mp edge_block0080 (i-80) (List.mem_range.mpr hp)
    have he : i-80+80 = i := by omega
    simpa only [he] using hv
  have hp : i-120 < 40 := by omega
  have hv := List.all_eq_true.mp edge_block0120 (i-120) (List.mem_range.mpr hp)
  have he : i-120+120 = i := by omega
  simpa only [he] using hv
#print axioms edge_batch00
end CubeChecker
```

### `CubeEveryEdge.lean`

```lean
import CubeEdgeBatch00
import CubeEdgeBatch01
import CubeEdgeBatch02
import CubeEdgeBatch03
import CubeEdgeBatch04
import CubeEdgeBatch05
import CubeEdgeBatch06
import CubeEdgeBatch07
import CubeEdgeBatch08
import CubeEdgeBatch09
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega
namespace CubeChecker
theorem every_edge_valid : ∀ i, i < cubeEdges.size → validEdge cubeEdges[i]! = true := by
  intro i hi
  have hsize : cubeEdges.size = 1441 := by decide +kernel
  rw [hsize] at hi
  by_cases h0 : i < 160
  · exact edge_batch00 i (by omega) h0
  by_cases h1 : i < 320
  · exact edge_batch01 i (by omega) h1
  by_cases h2 : i < 480
  · exact edge_batch02 i (by omega) h2
  by_cases h3 : i < 640
  · exact edge_batch03 i (by omega) h3
  by_cases h4 : i < 800
  · exact edge_batch04 i (by omega) h4
  by_cases h5 : i < 960
  · exact edge_batch05 i (by omega) h5
  by_cases h6 : i < 1120
  · exact edge_batch06 i (by omega) h6
  by_cases h7 : i < 1280
  · exact edge_batch07 i (by omega) h7
  by_cases h8 : i < 1440
  · exact edge_batch08 i (by omega) h8
  exact edge_batch09 i (by omega) hi
#print axioms every_edge_valid
end CubeChecker
```

### `CubeFastChecker.lean`

```lean
import CubeChecker
namespace CubeChecker
def checkStateAt (edges : Array CubeEdge) (states : Nat → State) (size j : Nat) : Bool :=
  if _h : j < size then
    let st := states j
    st.mask < 2^36 &&
    match st.act with
    | .leaf pack => checkLeaf edges st.mask pack
    | .branch e children =>
      e < edges.size && edges[e]!.mask > 0 && contained edges[e]!.mask st.mask &&
      let is := indices edges[e]!.mask
      children.length == is.length &&
      (is.zip children).all (fun (i,c) =>
        c < j && (states c).mask == st.mask ^^^ (1 <<< i))
  else false

end CubeChecker
```

### `CubeCertificateSoundness.lean`

```lean
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.BigOperators.Group.Finset
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

set_option autoImplicit false
open scoped BigOperators
namespace CubeCertificate

/-- Soundness of every integer hyperedge-packing leaf, allowing arbitrary
positive or zero integer coefficients and arbitrary repeated hyperedges. -/
theorem packing_leaf_bound
    {V I : Type*} [DecidableEq V] [Fintype I]
    (w : V → ℕ) (E : I → Finset V) (lam : I → ℕ)
    (M S : Finset V) (T : ℕ)
    (hSM : S ⊆ M) (hEM : ∀ i, E i ⊆ M)
    (avoid : ∀ i, ∃ v ∈ E i, v ∉ S)
    (capacity : ∀ v ∈ M, (∑ i, if v ∈ E i then lam i else 0) ≤ w v)
    (numeric : (∑ v ∈ M, w v) ≤ T + ∑ i, lam i) :
    (∑ v ∈ S, w v) ≤ T := by
  have pay_each (i : I) :
      lam i ≤ ∑ v ∈ M \ S, if v ∈ E i then lam i else 0 := by
    obtain ⟨v, hvE, hvS⟩ := avoid i
    have hvM : v ∈ M \ S := Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hEM i hvE, hvS⟩
    have h := Finset.single_le_sum (fun (b : V) (_ : b ∈ M \ S) =>
      Nat.zero_le (if b ∈ E i then lam i else 0)) hvM
    simpa only [ite_eq_left hvE] using h
  have pay : (∑ i, lam i) ≤ ∑ v ∈ M \ S, w v := by
    calc
      (∑ i, lam i) ≤ ∑ i, ∑ v ∈ M \ S, if v ∈ E i then lam i else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => pay_each i)
      _ = ∑ v ∈ M \ S, ∑ i, if v ∈ E i then lam i else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_comm
      _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ M \ S, w v := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun v hv =>
        capacity v (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hv).1)
  have split : (∑ v ∈ M \ S, w v) + (∑ v ∈ S, w v) = ∑ v ∈ M, w v :=
    Finset.sum_sdiff hSM
  omega

/-- Soundness of a branch. One forbidden edge supplies a missing vertex;
all strictly smaller deletion children must carry the claimed bound. -/
theorem deletion_branch_bound
    {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V] (w : V → ℕ)
    (M E : Finset V) (T : ℕ)
    (children : ∀ v ∈ E, ∀ S : Finset V, S ⊆ M.erase v →
      (∃ x ∈ E, x ∉ S) → (∑ x ∈ S, w x) ≤ T) :
    ∀ S : Finset V, S ⊆ M → (∃ x ∈ E, x ∉ S) → (∑ x ∈ S, w x) ≤ T := by
  intro S hSM avoid
  obtain ⟨v, hvE, hvS⟩ := avoid
  apply children v hvE S
  · intro x hx
    exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨by intro h; exact hvS (h ▸ hx), hSM hx⟩
  · exact ⟨v, hvE, hvS⟩

#print axioms packing_leaf_bound
#print axioms deletion_branch_bound
end CubeCertificate
```

### `CubeSemanticLeaf.lean`

```lean
import CubeChecker
import CubeCertificateSoundness
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin

set_option autoImplicit false
open scoped BigOperators
namespace CubeChecker

def maskSet (m : Nat) : Finset Nat := (indices m).toFinset

lemma foldl_weight {A : Type*} (f : A → Nat) (l : List A) (s : Nat) :
    l.foldl (fun b a => b + f a) s = s + (l.map f).sum := by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih => simp only [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Nat.add_assoc]

lemma indices_nodup (m : Nat) : (indices m).Nodup :=
  (List.nodup_range (n := 36)).filter _

lemma maskSet_mem (m i : Nat) : i ∈ maskSet m ↔ i < 36 ∧ member m i = true := by
  simp [maskSet, indices, vertices]

lemma weighted_eq (m : Nat) : weighted m = ∑ v ∈ maskSet m, weight v := by
  rw [weighted, foldl_weight, Nat.zero_add]
  exact (List.sum_toFinset weight (indices_nodup m)).symm

lemma contained_subset {a b : Nat} (h : contained a b = true) : maskSet a ⊆ maskSet b := by
  have he : a &&& b = a := by simpa [contained] using h
  intro i hi
  rw [maskSet_mem] at hi ⊢
  refine ⟨hi.1, ?_⟩
  have htest : (a &&& b).testBit i = true := by rw [he]; exact hi.2
  rw [Nat.testBit_land] at htest
  exact (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp htest).2

lemma checked_leaf_semantic
    (edges : Array CubeEdge) (m : Nat) (pack : List (Nat × Nat))
    (hc : checkLeaf edges m pack = true)
    (S : Finset Nat) (hS : S ⊆ maskSet m)
    (avoid : ∀ e, e < edges.size → ∃ v ∈ maskSet edges[e]!.mask, v ∉ S) :
    (∑ v ∈ S, weight v) ≤ 4131 := by
  have hp : ∀ p ∈ pack, 0 < p.2 ∧ p.1 < edges.size ∧ contained edges[p.1]!.mask m = true := by
    simpa only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] using
      (show pack.all (fun (e,k) => k > 0 && (e < edges.size && contained edges[e]!.mask m)) = true from
        (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hc).1).1)
  have hl : ∀ i ∈ vertices,
      pack.foldl (fun s (e,k) => s + if member edges[e]!.mask i then k else 0) 0 ≤ weight i := by
    intro i hi
    exact of_decide_eq_true (List.all_eq_true.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hc).1).2 i hi)
  have hn : weighted m ≤ 4131 + (pack.map Prod.snd).sum :=
    of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hc).2
  let E : Fin pack.length → Finset Nat := fun i => maskSet edges[(pack[i.val]).1]!.mask
  let lam : Fin pack.length → Nat := fun i => (pack[i.val]).2
  apply CubeCertificate.packing_leaf_bound weight E lam (maskSet m) S 4131 hS
  · intro i
    exact contained_subset (hp pack[i.val] (List.getElem_mem i.isLt)).2.2
  · intro i
    exact avoid (pack[i.val]).1 (hp pack[i.val] (List.getElem_mem i.isLt)).2.1
  · intro v hv
    have hv' : v ∈ vertices := by
      have := (maskSet_mem m v).mp hv
      simpa [vertices] using this.1
    have load := hl v hv'
    rw [foldl_weight, Nat.zero_add] at load
    have hs : (∑ i : Fin pack.length,
        if v ∈ E i then lam i else 0) =
        (pack.map (fun p => if member edges[p.1]!.mask v then p.2 else 0)).sum := by
      have hv36 : v < 36 := ((maskSet_mem m v).mp hv).1
      simp only [E, lam, maskSet_mem, hv36, true_and]
      exact Fin.sum_univ_fun_getElem pack (fun p => if member edges[p.1]!.mask v then p.2 else 0)
    rw [hs]
    exact load
  · rw [← weighted_eq]
    simpa only [lam, Fin.sum_univ_fun_getElem] using hn

#print axioms checked_leaf_semantic
end CubeChecker
```

### `CubeFastSemantics.lean`

```lean
import CubeSemanticLeaf
import CubeFastChecker
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option maxRecDepth 10000
open scoped BigOperators
namespace CubeChecker

lemma subset_toggle_fast {S : Finset Nat} {m v : Nat}
    (hS : S ⊆ maskSet m) (hv : v ∉ S) : S ⊆ maskSet (m ^^^ (1 <<< v)) := by
  intro i hi
  have hm := (maskSet_mem m i).mp (hS hi)
  rw [maskSet_mem]
  refine ⟨hm.1, ?_⟩
  have hne : v ≠ i := by intro h; exact hv (h.symm ▸ hi)
  simp only [member, Nat.testBit_xor, Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.one_mul,
    Nat.testBit_two_pow_of_ne hne, Bool.bne_false]
  exact hm.2

lemma checked_statesAt_semantic
    (edges : Array CubeEdge) (states : Nat → State) (size : Nat)
    (checked : ∀ j, j < size → checkStateAt edges states size j = true) :
    ∀ j, j < size → ∀ S : Finset Nat, S ⊆ maskSet (states j).mask →
      (∀ e, e < edges.size → ∃ v ∈ maskSet edges[e]!.mask, v ∉ S) →
      (∑ v ∈ S, weight v) ≤ 4131 := by
  intro j
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h j ih =>
    intro hj S hSM avoid
    have hc := checked j hj
    simp only [checkStateAt, dite_eq_left hj] at hc
    have ha := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hc).2
    cases he : (states j).act with
    | leaf pack =>
      simp only [he] at ha
      exact checked_leaf_semantic edges (states j).mask pack ha S hSM avoid
    | branch e cs =>
      simp only [he, Bool.and_eq_true] at ha
      rcases ha with ⟨⟨⟨heSize, hePos⟩, heSub⟩, hRest⟩
      have heSize' : e < edges.size := of_decide_eq_true heSize
      obtain ⟨v, hvE, hvS⟩ := avoid e heSize'
      have hvL : v ∈ indices edges[e]!.mask := List.mem_toFinset.mp hvE
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpv⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hvL
      have hlen : cs.length = (indices edges[e]!.mask).length := by
        simpa only [beq_iff_eq] using hRest.1
      have hp' : p < cs.length := by omega
      let c := cs[p]
      have hzip : (v,c) ∈ (indices edges[e]!.mask).zip cs := by
        have h : p < ((indices edges[e]!.mask).zip cs).length := by simp only [List.length_zip]; omega
        have H := List.getElem_mem h
        simpa only [List.getElem_zip, hpv] using H
      have hchild := List.all_eq_true.mp hRest.2 (v,c) hzip
      have hcj : c < j := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hchild).1
      have hmask : (states c).mask = (states j).mask ^^^ (1 <<< v) := by
        simpa only [beq_iff_eq] using (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hchild).2
      apply ih c hcj (lt_trans hcj hj) S
      · rw [hmask]
        exact subset_toggle_fast hSM hvS
      · exact avoid

#print axioms checked_statesAt_semantic
end CubeChecker
```

```lean
set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators
namespace CubeChecker

lemma subset_toggle {S : Finset Nat} {m v : Nat}
    (hS : S ⊆ maskSet m) (hv : v ∉ S) : S ⊆ maskSet (m ^^^ (1 <<< v)) := by
  intro i hi
  have hm := (maskSet_mem m i).mp (hS hi)
  rw [maskSet_mem]
  refine ⟨hm.1, ?_⟩
  have hne : v ≠ i := by intro h; exact hv (h.symm ▸ hi)
  simp only [member, Nat.testBit_xor, Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.one_mul,
    Nat.testBit_two_pow_of_ne hne, Bool.bne_false]
  exact hm.2

lemma checked_states_semantic
    (edges : Array CubeEdge) (states : Array State)
    (checked : ∀ j, j < states.size → checkState edges states j = true) :
    ∀ j, j < states.size → ∀ S : Finset Nat, S ⊆ maskSet states[j]!.mask →
      (∀ e, e < edges.size → ∃ v ∈ maskSet edges[e]!.mask, v ∉ S) →
      (∑ v ∈ S, weight v) ≤ 4131 := by
  intro j
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h j ih =>
    intro hj S hSM avoid
    simp only [getElem!_pos states j hj] at hSM
    have hc := checked j hj
    simp only [checkState, dite_eq_left hj] at hc
    have ha := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hc).2
    cases he : states[j].act with
    | leaf pack =>
      simp only [he] at ha
      exact checked_leaf_semantic edges states[j].mask pack ha S hSM avoid
    | branch e cs =>
      simp only [he, Bool.and_eq_true] at ha
      rcases ha with ⟨⟨⟨heSize, hePos⟩, heSub⟩, hRest⟩
      have heSize' : e < edges.size := of_decide_eq_true heSize
      obtain ⟨v, hvE, hvS⟩ := avoid e heSize'
      have hvL : v ∈ indices edges[e]!.mask := List.mem_toFinset.mp hvE
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpv⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hvL
      have hlen : cs.length = (indices edges[e]!.mask).length := by
        simpa only [beq_iff_eq] using hRest.1
      have hp' : p < cs.length := by omega
      let c := cs[p]
      have hzip : (v,c) ∈ (indices edges[e]!.mask).zip cs := by
        have h : p < ((indices edges[e]!.mask).zip cs).length := by simp only [List.length_zip]; omega
        have H := List.getElem_mem h
        simpa only [List.getElem_zip, hpv] using H
      have hchild := List.all_eq_true.mp hRest.2 (v,c) hzip
      have hcj : c < j := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hchild).1
      have hmask : states[c]!.mask = states[j].mask ^^^ (1 <<< v) := by
        simpa only [beq_iff_eq] using (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hchild).2
      apply ih c hcj (lt_trans hcj hj) S
      · rw [hmask]
        exact subset_toggle hSM hvS
      · exact avoid

#print axioms checked_states_semantic
end CubeChecker
```

### `CubeEdgeSemantics.lean`

```lean
import CubeSemanticBranch
import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Hom.Defs

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option maxRecDepth 10000
namespace CubeChecker

def coordinate (i : Nat) : Int := if i < 18 then (i : Int)-18 else (i : Int)-17

def cubeTerms (e : CubeEdge) : List Int :=
  [e.a,e.b,e.c,e.a+e.b,e.a+e.c,e.b+e.c,e.a+e.b+e.c]

lemma index_lt_of_inside (x : Int) (hx : inside x = true) : index x < 36 := by
  have h := of_decide_eq_true hx
  dsimp [index]
  split <;> omega

lemma coordinate_index (x : Int) (hx : inside x = true) : coordinate (index x) = x := by
  have h := of_decide_eq_true hx
  dsimp [index, coordinate]
  split <;> split <;> omega

lemma folded_bit_preserved (xs : List Int) (m i : Nat) (hm : m.testBit i = true) :
    (xs.foldl (fun m x => m ||| (1 <<< index x)) m).testBit i = true := by
  induction xs generalizing m with
  | nil => exact hm
  | cons x xs ih =>
    apply ih
    simp only [Nat.testBit_lor, hm, Bool.true_or]

lemma folded_bit_of_mem (xs : List Int) (x : Int) (hx : x ∈ xs) (m : Nat) :
    (xs.foldl (fun m x => m ||| (1 <<< index x)) m).testBit (index x) = true := by
  induction xs generalizing m with
  | nil => simp only [List.not_mem_nil] at hx
  | cons y ys ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with hxy | hxy
    · subst y
      rw [List.foldl_cons]
      apply folded_bit_preserved ys
      simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
    · exact ih hxy _

lemma valid_edge_term_mem (e : CubeEdge) (he : validEdge e = true)
    (x : Int) (hx : x ∈ cubeTerms e) :
    index x ∈ maskSet e.mask ∧ coordinate (index x) = x := by
  have hin : inside x = true := by
    have := List.all_eq_true.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp he).1 x
    exact this hx
  have hm : cubeMask e = e.mask := by
    simpa only [beq_iff_eq] using (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp he).2
  refine ⟨(maskSet_mem _ _).mpr ⟨index_lt_of_inside x hin, ?_⟩, coordinate_index x hin⟩
  rw [← hm]
  exact folded_bit_of_mem (cubeTerms e) x hx 0

def CubeFree {G : Type*} [Add G] (A : Set G) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y z : G, ¬ (x ∈ A ∧ y ∈ A ∧ z ∈ A ∧ x+y ∈ A ∧
    x+z ∈ A ∧ y+z ∈ A ∧ x+y+z ∈ A)

noncomputable def pullback {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (f : Int →+ G) (A : Set G) : Finset Nat := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.range 36).filter (fun i => f (coordinate i) ∈ A)

lemma cube_free_avoids_valid_edge {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (f : Int →+ G) (A : Set G) (hA : CubeFree A)
    (e : CubeEdge) (he : validEdge e = true) :
    ∃ v ∈ maskSet e.mask, v ∉ pullback f A := by
  classical
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have all_terms (x : Int) (hx : x ∈ cubeTerms e) : f x ∈ A := by
    obtain ⟨hm, hcoord⟩ := valid_edge_term_mem e he x hx
    have hi := h (index x) hm
    have hf : f (coordinate (index x)) ∈ A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    rwa [hcoord] at hf
  have terms := all_terms
  apply hA (f e.a) (f e.b) (f e.c)
  have ha := terms e.a (by simp [cubeTerms])
  have hb := terms e.b (by simp [cubeTerms])
  have hc := terms e.c (by simp [cubeTerms])
  have hab := terms (e.a+e.b) (by simp [cubeTerms])
  have hac := terms (e.a+e.c) (by simp [cubeTerms])
  have hbc := terms (e.b+e.c) (by simp [cubeTerms])
  have habc := terms (e.a+e.b+e.c) (by simp [cubeTerms])
  exact ⟨ha,hb,hc,by simpa only [map_add] using hab,
    by simpa only [map_add] using hac,by simpa only [map_add] using hbc,
    by simpa only [map_add] using habc⟩

end CubeChecker
```

```lean
import CubeEveryEdge
import CubeEveryState
import CubeFastSemantics
import CubeEdgeSemantics

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxRecDepth 1000000
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
namespace CubeChecker

theorem root_mask : (stateAt 12563).mask = 2^36-1 := by decide +kernel

theorem full_mask : maskSet (2^36-1) = Finset.range 36 := by decide +kernel

/-- The certified integer-pattern inequality, for every additive homomorphism
into any abelian group and every source-faithful cube-free set. -/
theorem finite_cube_weight_bound {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (f : Int →+ G) (A : Set G) (hA : CubeFree A) :
    (∑ v ∈ pullback f A, weight v) ≤ 4131 := by
  classical
  apply checked_statesAt_semantic cubeEdges stateAt 12564 every_state_valid 12563
    (by decide) (pullback f A)
  · rw [root_mask, full_mask]
    exact Finset.filter_subset _ _
  · intro e he
    exact cube_free_avoids_valid_edge f A hA cubeEdges[e]! (every_edge_valid e he)

#print axioms finite_cube_weight_bound
end CubeChecker
```

### `CubeGroupTools.lean`

```lean
import CubeEdgeSemantics
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option maxRecDepth 100000
open scoped BigOperators
namespace CubeChecker

lemma zero_excluded {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] {A : Set G}
    (hA : CubeFree A) : (0 : G) ∉ A := by
  intro h
  apply hA 0 0 0
  simpa only [zero_add] using And.intro h (And.intro h (And.intro h
    (And.intro h (And.intro h (And.intro h h)))))

lemma cube_free_preimage {G H : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup H]
    (f : H →+ G) {A : Set G} (hA : CubeFree A) : CubeFree (f ⁻¹' A) := by
  intro x y z h
  apply hA (f x) (f y) (f z)
  simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, map_add] using h

def mod8Extremizer : Finset (ZMod 8) := {1,3,4,5,7}

theorem mod8_extremizer_cube_free : CubeFree (mod8Extremizer : Set (ZMod 8)) := by
  unfold CubeFree
  change ∀ x y z : ZMod 8, ¬ (x ∈ mod8Extremizer ∧ y ∈ mod8Extremizer ∧ z ∈ mod8Extremizer ∧ x+y ∈ mod8Extremizer ∧ x+z ∈ mod8Extremizer ∧ y+z ∈ mod8Extremizer ∧ x+y+z ∈ mod8Extremizer)
  decide +kernel

theorem mod8_extremizer_card : mod8Extremizer.card = 5 := by decide +kernel

def coefficientLevel (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  let t := (coordinate i).natAbs
  if t%2=1 then 0 else if t%4=2 then 1 else if t%8=4 then 2 else if t%16=8 then 3 else 4

def layerWeight (j : Nat) : Nat :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 36, if coefficientLevel i = j then weight i else 0

theorem layerWeight_values : layerWeight 0 = 2906 ∧ layerWeight 1 = 2048 ∧
    layerWeight 2 = 1024 ∧ layerWeight 3 = 512 ∧ layerWeight 4 = 200 := by
  decide +kernel

theorem coefficient_factorizations : ∀ i : Fin 36,
    let t := (coordinate i.val).natAbs
    let j := coefficientLevel i.val
    let k := t / 2^j
    t = 2^j*k ∧ k%2=1 ∧ 1≤k ∧ k≤17 ∧ j≤4 := by
  decide +kernel

#print axioms zero_excluded
#print axioms cube_free_preimage
#print axioms mod8_extremizer_cube_free
end CubeChecker
```

### `CubeFiniteAveraging.lean`

```lean
import CubeGroupTools

set_option Elab.async false
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 100000
noncomputable section
namespace CubeChecker
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open scoped BigOperators
variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]

def scalarHom (x : G) : Int →+ G where
  toFun k := k • x
  map_zero' := zero_zsmul x
  map_add' a b := add_zsmul x a b

/-- Finite counting form of averaging: no division or density convention. -/
theorem finite_average_of_pointwise (A : Set G) (X : Finset G)
    (hlocal : ∀ x ∈ X, (∑ i ∈ pullback (scalarHom x) A, weight i) ≤ 4131) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 36, weight i *
      (X.filter (fun x => coordinate i • x ∈ A)).card) ≤ 4131 * X.card := by
  have he : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 36, weight i *
      (X.filter (fun x => coordinate i • x ∈ A)).card) =
      ∑ x ∈ X, ∑ i ∈ pullback (scalarHom x) A, weight i := by
    have hp (x : G) : pullback (scalarHom x) A =
        (Finset.range 36).filter (fun i => coordinate i • x ∈ A) := by rfl
    simp_rw [hp, Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.mul_sum,
      mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
    exact Finset.sum_comm (s := Finset.range 36) (t := X)
      (f := fun i x => if coordinate i • x ∈ A then weight i else 0)
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _x ∈ X, 4131 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro x hx
      exact hlocal x hx
    _ = 4131 * X.card := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]

#print axioms finite_average_of_pointwise
end CubeChecker
```

### `CubeAveraging.lean`

```lean
import CubeFiniteBound
import CubeFiniteAveraging

set_option Elab.async false
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace CubeChecker
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open scoped BigOperators

/-- Exact finite weighted averaging, for any finite multiplier set. -/
theorem finite_cube_average {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G]
    (A : Set G) (hA : CubeFree A) (X : Finset G) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 36, weight i *
      (X.filter (fun x => coordinate i • x ∈ A)).card) ≤ 4131 * X.card := by
  apply finite_average_of_pointwise A X
  intro x _
  exact finite_cube_weight_bound (scalarHom x) A hA

#print axioms finite_cube_average
end CubeChecker
```

### `CubeDyadicTools.lean`

```lean
import Mathlib.GroupTheory.SpecificGroups.Cyclic
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
namespace CubeDyadic

variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Finite G]

def powerSubgroup (G : Type*) [AddCommGroup G] (j : Nat) : AddSubgroup G :=
  (nsmulAddMonoidHom (2^j) : G →+ G).range

lemma twoPow_dvd {j n : Nat} (hj : j ≤ n) : 2^j ∣ 2^n := by
  refine ⟨2^(n-j), ?_⟩
  rw [← pow_add]
  congr 1
  omega

lemma scalar_ker_card {n j : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hj : j ≤ n) :
    Nat.card (nsmulAddMonoidHom (2^j) : G →+ G).ker = 2^j := by
  rw [IsAddCyclic.card_nsmulAddMonoidHom_ker G, hcard, Nat.gcd_eq_right (twoPow_dvd hj)]

lemma power_subgroup_card {n j : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hj : j ≤ n) :
    Nat.card (powerSubgroup G j) = 2^(n-j) := by
  unfold powerSubgroup
  rw [IsAddCyclic.card_nsmulAddMonoidHom_range G, hcard, Nat.gcd_eq_right (twoPow_dvd hj)]
  have hp : 2^n = 2^(n-j)*2^j := by
    rw [← pow_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [hp, Nat.mul_div_cancel _ (Nat.two_pow_pos _)]

lemma scalar_ker_even {n j : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hj : j < n) :
    (nsmulAddMonoidHom (2^j) : G →+ G).ker ≤ powerSubgroup G 1 := by
  apply IsAddCyclic.addSubgroup_le_iff_card_dvd.mpr
  rw [scalar_ker_card hcard (Nat.le_of_lt hj), power_subgroup_card hcard (by omega : 1≤n)]
  exact twoPow_dvd (by omega)

lemma in_next_iff {n j : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hj : j < n) (x : G) :
    (2^j) • x ∈ powerSubgroup G (j+1) ↔ x ∈ powerSubgroup G 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    change ∃ z : G, (2^(j+1)) • z = (2^j) • x at h
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := h
    have hz' : (2^j) • (2 • z) = (2^j) • x := by
      simpa only [pow_succ', mul_nsmul] using hz
    have hk : x-2•z ∈ (nsmulAddMonoidHom (2^j) : G →+ G).ker := by
      change (2^j) • (x-2•z) = 0
      rw [nsmul_sub, hz', sub_self]
    have he := scalar_ker_even hcard hj hk
    have hzH : 2•z ∈ powerSubgroup G 1 := by exact ⟨z,rfl⟩
    have hh := (powerSubgroup G 1).add_mem he hzH
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hh
  · intro h
    change ∃ z : G, 2•z=x at h
    obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := h
    change ∃ y : G, (2^(j+1)) • y = (2^j) • (2•z)
    exact ⟨z, by rw [pow_succ', mul_nsmul]⟩

#print axioms scalar_ker_card
#print axioms power_subgroup_card
#print axioms scalar_ker_even
#print axioms in_next_iff
end CubeDyadic
```

### `CubeFiberTools.lean`

```lean
import CubeDyadicTools
import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Index
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
noncomputable section
namespace CubeDyadic
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G]

lemma scalar_fiber_card {n j : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hj : j ≤ n)
    (y : G) (hy : y ∈ powerSubgroup G j) :
    ({x : G | (2^j) • x = y} : Finset G).card = 2^j := by
  let f : G →+ G := nsmulAddMonoidHom (2^j)
  have hy' : y ∈ Set.range f := hy
  have hz : (0 : G) ∈ Set.range f := ⟨0, f.map_zero⟩
  have he := AddMonoidHom.card_fiber_eq_of_mem_range f hy' hz
  change ({x : G | f x = y} : Finset G).card = 2^j
  rw [he]
  have hk := scalar_ker_card hcard hj
  change Nat.card {x : G // f x = 0} = 2^j at hk
  simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype] using hk

lemma odd_scalar_fiber_card {n j : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hj : j < n)
    (y : G) (hy : y ∈ powerSubgroup G j) (hy' : y ∉ powerSubgroup G (j+1)) :
    ({x : G | x ∉ powerSubgroup G 1 ∧ (2^j) • x = y} : Finset G).card = 2^j := by
  classical
  have sets : ({x : G | x ∉ powerSubgroup G 1 ∧ (2^j) • x = y} : Finset G) =
      ({x : G | (2^j) • x = y} : Finset G) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · exact And.right
    · intro h
      refine ⟨?_, h⟩
      intro hx
      have hnext := (in_next_iff hcard hj x).mpr hx
      rw [h] at hnext
      exact hy' hnext
  rw [sets]
  exact scalar_fiber_card hcard (Nat.le_of_lt hj) y hy

#print axioms scalar_fiber_card
#print axioms odd_scalar_fiber_card
end CubeDyadic
```

### `CubeUnitTools.lean`

```lean
import CubeFiberTools

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
namespace CubeDyadic

variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Fintype G]

omit [IsAddCyclic G] [Fintype G] in
lemma nsmul_interchange (a b : Nat) (x : G) : a • (b • x) = b • (a • x) := by
  rw [← mul_nsmul, ← mul_nsmul, Nat.mul_comm]

lemma coprime_scalar_bijective (d : Nat) (hc : (Nat.card G).Coprime d) :
    Function.Bijective (fun x : G => d • x) := by
  let f : G →+ G := nsmulAddMonoidHom d
  have hk : Nat.card f.ker = 1 :=
    (IsAddCyclic.card_nsmulAddMonoidHom_ker G d).trans hc.gcd_eq_one
  have hb : f.ker = ⊥ := (AddSubgroup.eq_bot_iff_card f.ker).mpr hk
  have hi : Function.Injective f := (AddMonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff f).mp hb
  exact ⟨hi, Finite.injective_iff_surjective.mp hi⟩

lemma coprime_scalar_preserves_power (d j : Nat) (hc : (Nat.card G).Coprime d) (x : G) :
    d • x ∈ powerSubgroup G j ↔ x ∈ powerSubgroup G j := by
  have hb := coprime_scalar_bijective d hc
  change (∃ z : G, (2^j) • z = d • x) ↔ (∃ z : G, (2^j) • z = x)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z,hz⟩
    obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := hb.surjective z
    change d•w=z at hw
    refine ⟨w, hb.injective ?_⟩
    rw [nsmul_interchange, hw]
    exact hz
  · rintro ⟨z,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨d•z, (nsmul_interchange d (2^j) z).symm⟩

#print axioms coprime_scalar_bijective
#print axioms coprime_scalar_preserves_power
end CubeDyadic
```

### `CubeCoefficientTools.lean`

```lean
import CubeUnitTools

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
noncomputable section
namespace CubeDyadic
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G]

lemma odd_unit_mul_fiber_card {n j : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hj : j<n)
    (d : Nat) (hc : (Nat.card G).Coprime d)
    (y : G) (hy : y ∈ powerSubgroup G j) (hy' : y ∉ powerSubgroup G (j+1)) :
    ({x : G | x ∉ powerSubgroup G 1 ∧ (2^j*d) • x = y} : Finset G).card = 2^j := by
  have hb := coprime_scalar_bijective d hc
  have hcount := odd_scalar_fiber_card hcard hj y hy hy'
  apply Eq.trans ?_ hcount
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun x _ => d • x)
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hx ⊢
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [coprime_scalar_preserves_power d 1 hc] using hx.1
    · simpa only [mul_nsmul, nsmul_interchange d (2^j)] using hx.2
  · intro x _ z _ he
    exact hb.injective he
  · intro z hz
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hz
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hb.surjective z
    change d • x = z at hx
    refine ⟨x, ?_, hx⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hp := coprime_scalar_preserves_power d 1 hc x
      rw [hx] at hp
      exact fun h => hz.1 (hp.mpr h)
    · rw [mul_nsmul, nsmul_interchange d (2^j), hx]
      exact hz.2

omit [IsAddCyclic G] in
lemma odd_neg_scalar_fiber_card (q : Nat) (y : G) :
    ({x : G | x ∉ powerSubgroup G 1 ∧ -(q • x) = y} : Finset G).card =
    ({x : G | x ∉ powerSubgroup G 1 ∧ q • x = y} : Finset G).card := by
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun x _ => -x)
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hx ⊢
    exact ⟨by simpa using hx.1, by simpa using hx.2⟩
  · intro x _ z _ he
    exact neg_injective he
  · intro z hz
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hz
    refine ⟨-z, ?_, neg_neg z⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact ⟨by simpa using hz.1, by simpa using hz.2⟩

#print axioms odd_unit_mul_fiber_card
#print axioms odd_neg_scalar_fiber_card
end CubeDyadic
```

### `CubeSignedFiber.lean`

```lean
import CubeCoefficientTools
import CubeGroupTools
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime.Basic

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
noncomputable section
namespace CubeDyadic
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G]

lemma signed_scalar_fiber_card {n j : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hj : j<n)
    (t : Int) (d : Nat) (ht : t.natAbs = 2^j*d) (hd : Odd d)
    (y : G) (hy : y ∈ powerSubgroup G j) (hy' : y ∉ powerSubgroup G (j+1)) :
    ({x : G | x ∉ powerSubgroup G 1 ∧ t • x = y} : Finset G).card = 2^j := by
  have hc : (Nat.card G).Coprime d := by
    rw [hcard]
    exact (Nat.coprime_two_left.mpr hd).pow_left n
  have hp := odd_unit_mul_fiber_card hcard hj d hc y hy hy'
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq_iff.mp ht with ht' | ht'
  · simpa only [ht', natCast_zsmul] using hp
  · simp only [ht', neg_smul, natCast_zsmul]
    rw [odd_neg_scalar_fiber_card]
    exact hp

lemma coefficient_fiber_card {n : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n)
    (i : Fin 36) (hj : CubeChecker.coefficientLevel i.val < n)
    (y : G) (hy : y ∈ powerSubgroup G (CubeChecker.coefficientLevel i.val))
    (hy' : y ∉ powerSubgroup G (CubeChecker.coefficientLevel i.val+1)) :
    ({x : G | x ∉ powerSubgroup G 1 ∧ CubeChecker.coordinate i.val • x = y} : Finset G).card =
      2^(CubeChecker.coefficientLevel i.val) := by
  have hf := CubeChecker.coefficient_factorizations i
  dsimp only at hf
  apply signed_scalar_fiber_card hcard hj (CubeChecker.coordinate i.val)
    ((CubeChecker.coordinate i.val).natAbs / 2^(CubeChecker.coefficientLevel i.val)) hf.1
    ?_ y hy hy'
  exact Nat.odd_iff.mpr hf.2.1

#print axioms signed_scalar_fiber_card
#print axioms coefficient_fiber_card
end CubeDyadic
```

### `CubeLayerCounts.lean`

```lean
import CubeSignedFiber
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic

set_option Elab.async false
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 200000
noncomputable section
namespace CubeDyadic
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open scoped BigOperators

lemma uniform_preimage_card {G H : Type*} [DecidableEq H]
    (X : Finset G) (Y : Finset H) (f : G → H) (q : Nat)
    (hmap : ∀ x ∈ X, f x ∈ Y)
    (hcount : ∀ y ∈ Y, (X.filter (fun x => f x=y)).card=q)
    (A : Set H) :
    (X.filter (fun x => f x∈A)).card = q*(Y.filter (fun y => y∈A)).card := by
  have h := Finset.sum_card_fiberwise_eq_card_filter X (Y.filter (fun y => y∈A)) f
  have hf : X.filter (fun x => f x ∈ Y.filter (fun y => y∈A)) =
      X.filter (fun x => f x∈A) := by
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, hmap x hx, true_and]
  rw [hf] at h
  calc
    _ = ∑ y ∈ Y.filter (fun y => y∈A), (X.filter (fun x => f x=y)).card := h.symm
    _ = ∑ _y ∈ Y.filter (fun y => y∈A), q := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y hy
      exact hcount y (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).1
    _ = q*(Y.filter (fun y => y∈A)).card := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]

variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G]

omit [DecidableEq G] in
lemma odd_signed_image_layer {n j : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hj : j<n)
    (t : Int) (d : Nat) (ht : t.natAbs = 2^j*d) (hd : Odd d)
    (x : G) (hx : x ∉ powerSubgroup G 1) :
    t • x ∈ powerSubgroup G j ∧ t • x ∉ powerSubgroup G (j+1) := by
  have hc : (Nat.card G).Coprime d := by
    rw [hcard]
    exact (Nat.coprime_two_left.mpr hd).pow_left n
  have hodd : d • x ∉ powerSubgroup G 1 := by
    simpa only [coprime_scalar_preserves_power d 1 hc] using hx
  have hs : (2^j*d) • x = (2^j) • (d • x) := by
    rw [mul_nsmul, nsmul_interchange d (2^j)]
  have hp : (2^j*d) • x ∈ powerSubgroup G j := by
    rw [hs]
    exact ⟨d • x,rfl⟩
  have hp' : (2^j*d) • x ∉ powerSubgroup G (j+1) := by
    rw [hs, in_next_iff hcard hj]
    exact hodd
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq_iff.mp ht with ht' | ht'
  · simpa only [ht', natCast_zsmul] using And.intro hp hp'
  · simpa only [ht', neg_smul, natCast_zsmul, AddSubgroup.neg_mem_iff] using And.intro hp hp'

lemma signed_layer_hit_count {n j : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hj : j<n)
    (t : Int) (d : Nat) (ht : t.natAbs = 2^j*d) (hd : Odd d) (A : Set G) :
    ({x : G | x ∉ powerSubgroup G 1 ∧ t • x∈A} : Finset G).card =
      2^j * ({y : G | y∈powerSubgroup G j ∧ y∉powerSubgroup G (j+1) ∧ y∈A} : Finset G).card := by
  let X : Finset G := {x : G | x ∉ powerSubgroup G 1}
  let Y : Finset G := {y : G | y∈powerSubgroup G j ∧ y∉powerSubgroup G (j+1)}
  have hm : ∀ x∈X, t•x∈Y := by
    intro x hx
    have ho : x ∉ powerSubgroup G 1 := by simpa only [X, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hx
    have hi := odd_signed_image_layer hcard hj t d ht hd x ho
    simpa only [Y, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hi
  have hn : ∀ y∈Y, (X.filter (fun x => t•x=y)).card = 2^j := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : y∈powerSubgroup G j ∧ y∉powerSubgroup G (j+1) := by
      simpa only [Y, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hy
    simpa only [X, Finset.filter_filter] using signed_scalar_fiber_card hcard hj t d ht hd y hy'.1 hy'.2
  have he := uniform_preimage_card X Y (fun x => t•x) (2^j) hm hn A
  simpa only [X, Y, Finset.filter_filter, and_assoc] using he

#print axioms uniform_preimage_card
#print axioms odd_signed_image_layer
#print axioms signed_layer_hit_count
end CubeDyadic
```

```lean
import CubeDyadicTools

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace CubeDyadic
variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Finite G]

lemma power_subgroup_eq_bot {n j : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hj : n≤j) :
    powerSubgroup G j = ⊥ := by
  apply (AddSubgroup.eq_bot_iff_card _).mpr
  unfold powerSubgroup
  rw [IsAddCyclic.card_nsmulAddMonoidHom_range G, hcard,
    Nat.gcd_eq_left (twoPow_dvd hj), Nat.div_self (Nat.two_pow_pos n)]

lemma power_subgroup_card_all {n j : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) :
    Nat.card (powerSubgroup G j) = 2^(n-min n j) := by
  by_cases hj : j≤n
  · simpa only [Nat.min_eq_right hj] using power_subgroup_card hcard hj
  · have hn : n≤j := by omega
    rw [power_subgroup_eq_bot hcard hn]
    simp only [Nat.min_eq_left hn, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, Nat.card_unique]

#print axioms power_subgroup_eq_bot
#print axioms power_subgroup_card_all
end CubeDyadic
```

```lean
lemma signed_scalar_eq_zero_of_ge {n j : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n)

    exact hm
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq_iff.mp ht with ht' | ht'
  · simpa only [ht', natCast_zsmul] using hz
  · simpa only [ht', neg_smul, natCast_zsmul, neg_eq_zero] using hz
```

### `CubeWeightedProfile.lean`

```lean
import CubeAveraging
import CubeLayerCounts
import CubeScalarTail
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

set_option Elab.async false
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
noncomputable section
namespace CubeDyadic
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open scoped BigOperators
open CubeChecker

lemma evaluated_coefficient_sum (a : Nat → Nat) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 36, weight i * 2^(coefficientLevel i) * a (coefficientLevel i)) =
    2906*a 0 + 4096*a 1 + 4096*a 2 + 4096*a 3 + 3200*a 4 := by
  norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, weight, coefficientLevel, coordinate]
  ring

variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G]

def layerCount (A : Set G) (j : Nat) : Nat :=
  ({y : G | y∈powerSubgroup G j ∧ y∉powerSubgroup G (j+1) ∧ y∈A} : Finset G).card

/-- The five-layer profile, including every truncated small-order layer. -/
theorem five_layer_weighted_profile {n : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n)
    (A : Set G) (hA : CubeFree A) :
    2906*layerCount A 0 + 4096*layerCount A 1 + 4096*layerCount A 2 +
      4096*layerCount A 3 + 3200*layerCount A 4 ≤
      4131*({x : G | x∉powerSubgroup G 1} : Finset G).card := by
  let X : Finset G := {x : G | x∉powerSubgroup G 1}
  have hc (i : Nat) (hi : i∈Finset.range 36) :
      (X.filter (fun x => coordinate i • x∈A)).card =
        2^(coefficientLevel i) * layerCount A (coefficientLevel i) := by
    have hidx : i<36 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    have hf := coefficient_factorizations ⟨i,hidx⟩
    dsimp only at hf
    by_cases hj : coefficientLevel i<n
    · simpa only [X, Finset.filter_filter, layerCount] using
        signed_layer_hit_count hcard hj (coordinate i)
          ((coordinate i).natAbs/2^(coefficientLevel i)) hf.1 (Nat.odd_iff.mpr hf.2.1) A
    · have hj' : n≤coefficientLevel i := by omega
      have hz (x : G) : coordinate i • x = 0 :=
        signed_scalar_eq_zero_of_ge hcard hj' (coordinate i)
          ((coordinate i).natAbs/2^(coefficientLevel i)) hf.1 x
      have ha0 := zero_excluded hA
      have hl : layerCount A (coefficientLevel i) = 0 := by
        simp only [layerCount, power_subgroup_eq_bot hcard hj',
          power_subgroup_eq_bot hcard (show n≤coefficientLevel i+1 by omega)]
        simp
      rw [hl, Nat.mul_zero]
      have hempty : X.filter (fun x => coordinate i • x∈A) = ∅ := by
        apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr
        intro x _ hm
        rw [hz] at hm
        exact ha0 hm
      rw [hempty, Finset.card_empty]
  rw [← evaluated_coefficient_sum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 36, weight i * (X.filter (fun x => coordinate i • x∈A)).card := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [hc i hi]
      exact Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _
    _ ≤ 4131*X.card := finite_cube_average A hA X

#print axioms evaluated_coefficient_sum
#print axioms five_layer_weighted_profile
end CubeDyadic
```

### `CubeProfileScale.lean`

```lean
import CubeWeightedProfile

set_option Elab.async false
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 200000
noncomputable section
namespace CubeDyadic
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open CubeChecker
variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Fintype G]

lemma twice_odd_card {n : Nat} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hn : 1≤n) :
    2*({x : G | x∉powerSubgroup G 1} : Finset G).card = 2^n := by
  have he : ({x : G | x∈powerSubgroup G 1} : Finset G).card = 2^(n-1) := by
    have h := power_subgroup_card hcard hn
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype] using h
  have hpart := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset G)) (fun x => x∈powerSubgroup G 1)
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard] at hpart
  have hp : 2*2^(n-1)=2^n := by
    rw [← pow_succ']
    congr 1
    omega
  omega

theorem five_layer_integer_profile [DecidableEq G] {n : Nat}
    (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hn : 1≤n) (A : Set G) (hA : CubeFree A) :
    5812*layerCount A 0 + 8192*layerCount A 1 + 8192*layerCount A 2 +
      8192*layerCount A 3 + 6400*layerCount A 4 ≤ 4131*2^n := by
  have h := five_layer_weighted_profile hcard A hA
  have ho := twice_odd_card hcard hn
  omega

#print axioms twice_odd_card
#print axioms five_layer_integer_profile
end CubeDyadic
```

### `CubeLWCounts.lean`

```lean
import CubeLayerCounts
import CubeDyadicTail

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace LongWagner
open CubeChecker CubeDyadic
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Definitionally identical to the inherited profile's layerCount.
    Keeping the definition here makes the elementary counting independent of the certificate. -/
def layerCount {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] (A : Set G) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ({y : G | y∈powerSubgroup G j ∧ y∉powerSubgroup G (j+1) ∧ y∈A} : Finset G).card

def totalCount {G : Type*} [Fintype G] (A : Set G) : ℕ :=
  ({x : G | x∈A} : Finset G).card

def tailCount {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] (A : Set G) (j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ({x : G | x∈powerSubgroup G j ∧ x∈A} : Finset G).card

variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G]

omit [Fintype G] in
lemma powerSubgroup_antitone (j k : ℕ) (h : j ≤ k) :
    powerSubgroup G k ≤ powerSubgroup G j := by
  rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨(2^(k-j)) • y, ?_⟩
  change (2^j) • ((2^(k-j)) • y) = (2^k) • y
  rw [← mul_nsmul, ← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel h]

omit [Fintype G] in
lemma powerSubgroup_zero : powerSubgroup G 0 = ⊤ := by
  ext x
  simp [powerSubgroup]

lemma tail_zero (A : Set G) : tailCount A 0 = totalCount A := by
  simp [tailCount, totalCount, powerSubgroup_zero]

lemma tail_split (A : Set G) (j : ℕ) :
    tailCount A j = layerCount A j + tailCount A (j+1) := by
  have h := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := ({x : G | x∈powerSubgroup G j ∧ x∈A} : Finset G))
    (fun x => x∈powerSubgroup G (j+1))
  have hs : ({x : G | x∈powerSubgroup G j ∧ x∈A} : Finset G).filter
      (fun x => x∈powerSubgroup G (j+1)) =
      ({x : G | x∈powerSubgroup G (j+1) ∧ x∈A} : Finset G) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · tauto
    · rintro ⟨hx,ha⟩
      exact ⟨⟨powerSubgroup_antitone j (j+1) (by omega) hx,ha⟩,hx⟩
  have hl : ({x : G | x∈powerSubgroup G j ∧ x∈A} : Finset G).filter
      (fun x => x∉powerSubgroup G (j+1)) =
      ({x : G | x∈powerSubgroup G j ∧ x∉powerSubgroup G (j+1) ∧ x∈A} : Finset G) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    tauto
  rw [hs, hl] at h
  exact h.symm.trans (Nat.add_comm _ _)

lemma total_split_five (A : Set G) :
    totalCount A = layerCount A 0 + layerCount A 1 +
      layerCount A 2 + layerCount A 3 + layerCount A 4 + tailCount A 5 := by
  have h0 := tail_split A 0
  have h1 := tail_split A 1
  have h2 := tail_split A 2
  have h3 := tail_split A 3
  have h4 := tail_split A 4
  rw [tail_zero] at h0
  simp only [Nat.reduceAdd] at h0 h1 h2 h3 h4
  omega

lemma subtype_count (A : Set G) (H : AddSubgroup G) :
    totalCount (H.subtype ⁻¹' A) =
      ({x : G | x∈H ∧ x∈A} : Finset G).card := by
  unfold totalCount
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun x _ => x.val)
  · intro x hx
    have ha := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
    change (x : G)∈A at ha
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,x.property,ha⟩
  · intro x _ y _ h
    exact Subtype.ext h
  · intro y hy
    have hy' : y∈H ∧ y∈A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
    exact ⟨⟨y,hy'.1⟩, by simpa using hy'.2, rfl⟩

lemma tail_vanish [IsAddCyclic G] {n j : ℕ} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n)
    (hj : n≤j) (A : Set G) (hA : CubeFree A) : tailCount A j = 0 := by
  have hz := zero_excluded hA
  simp [tailCount, power_subgroup_eq_bot hcard hj, hz]

lemma twice_odd_card [IsAddCyclic G] {n : ℕ}
    (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hn : 1≤n) :
    2*({x : G | x∉powerSubgroup G 1} : Finset G).card = 2^n := by
  have he : ({x : G | x∈powerSubgroup G 1} : Finset G).card = 2^(n-1) := by
    have h := power_subgroup_card hcard hn
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype] using h
  have hpart := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset G)) (fun x => x∈powerSubgroup G 1)
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard] at hpart
  have hp : 2*2^(n-1)=2^n := by
    rw [← pow_succ']
    congr 1
    omega
  omega

lemma total_trivial [IsAddCyclic G] (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^0)
    (A : Set G) (hA : CubeFree A) : totalCount A = 0 := by
  rw [← tail_zero]
  exact tail_vanish hcard (by omega) A hA

def HighOddBound : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : Type) [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G],
    Nat.card G = 2^n →
    ∀ A : Set G, CubeFree A → 2^n < 3 * layerCount A 0 →
      8 * totalCount A ≤ 5 * 2^n

#print axioms total_split_five
#print axioms subtype_count
#print axioms tail_vanish
end LongWagner
```

### `CubeLWInduction.lean`

```lean
import CubeLWCounts
import CubeIntegerProfile
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace LongWagner
open CubeChecker CubeDyadic
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def CyclicUpper (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (G : Type) [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G],
    Nat.card G = 2^n →
    ∀ A : Set G, CubeFree A → 8 * totalCount A ≤ 5 * 2^n

def WeightedBound : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : Type) [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G],
    Nat.card G = 2^n → 1≤n →
    ∀ A : Set G, CubeFree A →
      5812*layerCount A 0 + 8192*layerCount A 1 + 8192*layerCount A 2 +
        8192*layerCount A 3 + 6400*layerCount A 4 ≤ 4131*2^n

lemma scaled_tail_of_induction {n : ℕ} (hn : 0<n)
    (ih : ∀ m<n, CyclicUpper m) (G : Type)
    [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G]
    (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (A : Set G) (hA : CubeFree A)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : 0<j) :
    8 * 2^j * tailCount A j ≤ 5 * 2^n := by
  by_cases hnj : n≤j
  · rw [tail_vanish hcard hnj A hA, Nat.mul_zero]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  · have hjn : j≤n := by omega
    have hsmall : n-min n j<n := by omega
    have hb := ih (n-min n j) hsmall (powerSubgroup G j)
      (power_subgroup_card_all hcard) ((powerSubgroup G j).subtype ⁻¹' A)
      (cube_free_preimage (powerSubgroup G j).subtype hA)
    rw [subtype_count, Nat.min_eq_right hjn] at hb
    change 8 * tailCount A j ≤ 5 * 2^(n-j) at hb
    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2^j) hb
    have hp : 2^j * 2^(n-j) = 2^n := by
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hjn]
    calc
      8 * 2^j * tailCount A j = 2^j * (8 * tailCount A j) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2^j * (5 * 2^(n-j)) := hm
      _ = 5 * 2^n := by rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm (2^j) 5, Nat.mul_assoc, hp]

/-- Strong subgroup induction, isolating the weighted profile and the high-odd branch. -/
theorem cyclic_upper_of_branches (profile : WeightedBound) (high : HighOddBound) : ∀ n, CyclicUpper n := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro G _ _ _ _ hcard A hA
    by_cases hn : n=0
    · subst n
      rw [total_trivial hcard A hA]
      decide
    · have hn' : 0<n := by omega
      by_cases hodd : 2^n < 3 * layerCount A 0
      · exact high n G hcard A hA hodd
      · have hp := profile n G hcard hn' A hA
        have h4 := scaled_tail_of_induction hn' ih G hcard A hA 4 (by omega)
        have h5 := scaled_tail_of_induction hn' ih G hcard A hA 5 (by omega)
        norm_num only [Nat.reducePow, Nat.reduceMul] at h4 h5
        rw [tail_split A 4] at h4
        exact CubeIntegerProfile.low_odd_closes (2^n) (layerCount A 0)
          (layerCount A 1) (layerCount A 2) (layerCount A 3) (layerCount A 4)
          (tailCount A 5) (totalCount A) (total_split_five A) hp
          (by omega) h4 h5

#print axioms scaled_tail_of_induction
#print axioms cyclic_upper_of_branches
end LongWagner
```

### `CubeLWFiniteCounting.lean`

```lean
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Fin
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card
import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Subgroup.Basic
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace LongWagner
open scoped BigOperators

/-- If every point misses a member, the total missing mass covers X. -/
theorem missing_mass {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ}
    (X : Finset α) (S : Fin k → Finset α) (hsub : ∀ i, S i ⊆ X)
    (hmiss : ∀ x∈X, ∃ i, x∉S i) :
    X.card + ∑ i, (S i).card ≤ k * X.card := by
  classical
  have hcover : X ⊆ Finset.univ.biUnion (fun i => X \ S i) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hmiss x hx
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hx,hi⟩⟩
  have hb := (Finset.card_le_card hcover).trans (Finset.card_biUnion_le)
  have he : (∑ i, (X \ S i).card) + (∑ i, (S i).card) = k * X.card := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp_rw [Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card (hsub _)]
    simp
  omega

theorem intersection_nonempty {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ}
    (X : Finset α) (S : Fin k → Finset α) (hsub : ∀ i, S i ⊆ X)
    (hlarge : k * X.card < X.card + ∑ i, (S i).card) :
    ∃ x∈X, ∀ i, x∈S i := by
  classical
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hb := missing_mass X S hsub h
  omega

/-- An additive sum-free subset of a finite group has at most half its size. -/
theorem sum_free_half_finset {G : Type*} [AddGroup G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G]
    (S : Finset G) (hS : ∀ u∈S, ∀ v∈S, u+v∉S) :
    2*S.card ≤ Fintype.card G := by
  classical
  by_cases hempty : S=∅
  · simp [hempty]
  · obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hempty
    let T := S.image (fun x => s+x)
    have hc : T.card = S.card :=
      Finset.card_image_of_injective S (fun _ _ h => add_left_cancel h)
    have hd : Disjoint S T := by
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro x hx hxT
      obtain ⟨v,hv,hxv⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hxT
      exact hS s hs v hv (hxv ▸ hx)
    have hb := Finset.card_le_univ (S∪T)
    rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd, hc] at hb
    omega

#print axioms missing_mass
#print axioms intersection_nonempty
#print axioms sum_free_half_finset
end LongWagner
```

### `CubeLWTranslates.lean`

```lean
import CubeLWCounts
import CubeLWFiniteCounting
import Mathlib.Data.Fin.VecNotation
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace LongWagner
open CubeChecker CubeDyadic
open scoped BigOperators
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G]

def oddSet : Finset G := {x | x∉powerSubgroup G 1}
def shiftedOdd (A : Set G) (e : G) : Finset G :=
  (oddSet : Finset G).filter (fun z => z+e∈A)

omit [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] in
lemma odd_add_even (z e : G) (he : e∈powerSubgroup G 1) :
    z+e∉powerSubgroup G 1 ↔ z∉powerSubgroup G 1 := by
  have hi : z+e∈powerSubgroup G 1 ↔ z∈powerSubgroup G 1 := by
    constructor
    · intro hz
      simpa using (powerSubgroup G 1).sub_mem hz he
    · intro hz
      exact (powerSubgroup G 1).add_mem hz he
  exact not_congr hi

omit [DecidableEq G] in
lemma shiftedOdd_card (A : Set G) (e : G) (he : e∈powerSubgroup G 1) :
    (shiftedOdd A e).card = layerCount A 0 := by
  unfold layerCount
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun x _ => x+e)
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : x∉powerSubgroup G 1 ∧ x+e∈A := by simpa [shiftedOdd,oddSet] using hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact ⟨by simp [powerSubgroup_zero], (odd_add_even x e he).mpr hx'.1,hx'.2⟩
  · intro x _ y _ h
    exact add_right_cancel h
  · intro y hy
    have hy' : y∈powerSubgroup G 0 ∧ y∉powerSubgroup G 1 ∧ y∈A :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
    refine ⟨y-e, ?_, sub_add_cancel y e⟩
    have ho : y-e∉powerSubgroup G 1 := by
      apply (odd_add_even (y-e) e he).mp
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hy'.2.1
    simpa [shiftedOdd,oddSet,ho] using hy'.2.2

lemma odd_translate_intersection {k : ℕ} [IsAddCyclic G] {n : ℕ}
    (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hn : 1≤n) (A : Set G)
    (e : Fin k → G) (he : ∀ i, e i∈powerSubgroup G 1)
    (hc : k * 2^n < 2^n + 2*k*layerCount A 0) :
    ∃ z∉powerSubgroup G 1, ∀ i, z+e i∈A := by
  have ho := twice_odd_card hcard hn
  change 2*(oddSet : Finset G).card=2^n at ho
  have hs : (∑ i, (shiftedOdd A (e i)).card) = k*layerCount A 0 := by
    simp_rw [shiftedOdd_card A _ (he _)]
    simp
  have hlarge : k*(oddSet : Finset G).card <
      (oddSet : Finset G).card + ∑ i, (shiftedOdd A (e i)).card := by
    rw [hs]
    rw [←ho] at hc
    ring_nf at hc ⊢
    omega
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hm⟩ := intersection_nonempty oddSet
    (fun i => shiftedOdd A (e i)) (fun i => Finset.filter_subset _ _) hlarge
  exact ⟨z,by simpa [oddSet] using hz,fun i => (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hm i)).2⟩

theorem high_odd_no_double [IsAddCyclic G] {n : ℕ}
    (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hn : 1≤n) (A : Set G) (hA : CubeFree A)
    (hc : 2^n < 3*layerCount A 0) (e : G) (he : e∈powerSubgroup G 1) :
    ¬ (e∈A ∧ 2•e∈A) := by
  rintro ⟨ha,hb⟩
  let es : Fin 3 → G := ![0,e,2•e]
  have hes : ∀ i, es i∈powerSubgroup G 1 := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [es, he, AddSubgroup.nsmul_mem]
  obtain ⟨z,_,hz⟩ := odd_translate_intersection hcard hn A es hes (by omega)
  have h0 : z∈A := by simpa [es] using hz 0
  have h1 : z+e∈A := by simpa [es] using hz 1
  have h2 : z+e+e∈A := by simpa [es,two_smul,add_assoc] using hz 2
  exact hA z e e ⟨h0,ha,ha,h1,h1,by simpa [two_smul] using hb,h2⟩

theorem high_odd_even_sum_free [IsAddCyclic G] {n : ℕ}
    (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hn : 1≤n) (A : Set G) (hA : CubeFree A)
    (hc : 3*2^n < 8*layerCount A 0) :
    ∀ u v, u∈powerSubgroup G 1 → v∈powerSubgroup G 1 →
      ¬ (u∈A ∧ v∈A ∧ u+v∈A) := by
  intro u v hu hv h
  let es : Fin 4 → G := ![0,u,v,u+v]
  have hes : ∀ i, es i∈powerSubgroup G 1 := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [es,hu,hv,AddSubgroup.add_mem]
  obtain ⟨z,_,hz⟩ := odd_translate_intersection hcard hn A es hes (by omega)
  apply hA z u v
  exact ⟨by simpa [es] using hz 0,h.1,h.2.1,
    by simpa [es] using hz 1,by simpa [es] using hz 2,h.2.2,
    by simpa [es,add_assoc] using hz 3⟩

#print axioms high_odd_no_double
#print axioms high_odd_even_sum_free
end LongWagner
```

### `CubeLWHighCounts.lean`

```lean
import CubeLWTranslates
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace LongWagner
open CubeChecker CubeDyadic
open scoped BigOperators
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [IsAddCyclic G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G]

lemma scalar_hit_card {n j : ℕ} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hj : j<n)
    (t : ℤ) (d : ℕ) (ht : t.natAbs=2^j*d) (hd : Odd d) (A : Set G) :
    ((oddSet : Finset G).filter (fun x => t•x∈A)).card = 2^j*layerCount A j := by
  simpa only [oddSet,Finset.filter_filter,layerCount] using
    signed_layer_hit_count hcard hj t d ht hd A

theorem diagonal_count {n : ℕ} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hn : 2≤n)
    (A : Set G) (hA : CubeFree A) :
    2*(layerCount A 0 + layerCount A 1) ≤ 2^n := by
  let S : Fin 3 → Finset G := fun i =>
    (oddSet : Finset G).filter (fun x => ((i.val+1 : ℕ) : ℤ)•x∈A)
  have hs : ∀ i, S i ⊆ oddSet := fun _ => Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hm : ∀ x∈(oddSet : Finset G), ∃ i, x∉S i := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have h1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (h 0)).2
    have h2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (h 1)).2
    have h3 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (h 2)).2
    change (1:ℤ)•x∈A at h1
    rw [one_zsmul] at h1
    change (2:ℤ)•x∈A at h2
    change (3:ℤ)•x∈A at h3
    have htwo : ((2:ℕ):ℤ)•x∈A := h2
    rw [natCast_zsmul,two_smul] at htwo
    have hthree : ((3:ℕ):ℤ)•x∈A := h3
    rw [natCast_zsmul,show (3:ℕ)=2+1 by rfl,add_nsmul,two_smul,one_nsmul] at hthree
    exact hA x x x ⟨h1,h1,h1,htwo,htwo,htwo,hthree⟩
  have hb := missing_mass oddSet S hs hm
  have h1 := scalar_hit_card hcard (show 0<n by omega) 1 1 (by decide) (by decide) A
  have h2 := scalar_hit_card hcard (show 1<n by omega) 2 1 (by decide) (by decide) A
  have h3 := scalar_hit_card hcard (show 0<n by omega) 3 3 (by decide) (by decide) A
  have ho := twice_odd_card hcard (show 1≤n by omega)
  change 2*(oddSet : Finset G).card=2^n at ho
  have he : (∑ i, (S i).card) = 2*layerCount A 0 + 2*layerCount A 1 := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ,Fin.sum_univ_zero,Nat.add_zero] 
    change ((oddSet : Finset G).filter (fun x => (1:ℤ)•x∈A)).card +
      (((oddSet : Finset G).filter (fun x => (2:ℤ)•x∈A)).card +
      (((oddSet : Finset G).filter (fun x => (3:ℤ)•x∈A)).card + 0)) = _
    rw [h1,h2,h3]
    omega
  rw [he] at hb
  omega

lemma even_double_hit_count {n : ℕ} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hn : 2≤n) (A : Set G) :
    ({x : G | x∈powerSubgroup G 1 ∧ 2•x∈A} : Finset G).card = 2*tailCount A 2 := by
  let X : Finset G := {x | x∈powerSubgroup G 1}
  let Y : Finset G := {x | x∈powerSubgroup G 2}
  have hm : ∀ x∈X, (2:ℕ)•x∈Y := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
    subst x
    simp only [Y,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
    refine ⟨z,?_⟩
    change (2*2:ℕ)•z=2•(2•z)
    rw [mul_nsmul]
  have hf : ∀ y∈Y, (X.filter (fun x => (2:ℕ)•x=y)).card=2 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : y∈powerSubgroup G 2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
    have he : X.filter (fun x => (2:ℕ)•x=y) =
        ({x : G | (2:ℕ)•x=y} : Finset G) := by
      ext x
      simp only [X,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
      constructor
      · tauto
      · intro hx
        refine ⟨?_,hx⟩
        apply (in_next_iff hcard (show 1<n by omega) x).mp
        simpa only [show 2^1=2 by decide,hx] using hy'
    rw [he]
    exact scalar_fiber_card hcard (show 1≤n by omega) y
      (powerSubgroup_antitone 1 2 (by omega) hy')
  simpa only [X,Y,Finset.filter_filter,tailCount] using
    uniform_preimage_card X Y (fun x => (2:ℕ)•x) 2 hm hf A

theorem no_double_count {n : ℕ} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hn : 2≤n) (A : Set G)
    (h : ∀ e∈powerSubgroup G 1, ¬ (e∈A ∧ 2•e∈A)) :
    6*tailCount A 1 ≤ 2^n + 4*layerCount A 1 := by
  let X : Finset G := {x | x∈powerSubgroup G 1}
  let S : Fin 2 → Finset G := ![X.filter (fun x => x∈A), X.filter (fun x => 2•x∈A)]
  have hs : ∀ i, S i ⊆ X := by intro i; fin_cases i <;> exact Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have hm : ∀ x∈X, ∃ i, x∉S i := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases ha : x∈A
    · refine ⟨1,?_⟩
      intro hxS
      exact h x (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2 ⟨ha,(Finset.mem_filter.mp hxS).2⟩
    · exact ⟨0,by simp [S,ha]⟩
  have hb := missing_mass X S hs hm
  have he0 : (X.filter (fun x => x∈A)).card = tailCount A 1 := by
    simp only [X,Finset.filter_filter,tailCount]
  have he2 : (X.filter (fun x => 2•x∈A)).card = 2*tailCount A 2 := by
    simpa only [X,Finset.filter_filter] using even_double_hit_count hcard hn A
  have he : (∑ i, (S i).card) = tailCount A 1 + 2*tailCount A 2 := by
    simp [S,Fin.sum_univ_succ,he0,he2]
  rw [he] at hb
  have ho := twice_odd_card hcard (show 1≤n by omega)
  have hp := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset G)) (fun x => x∈powerSubgroup G 1)
  simp only [Finset.card_univ,←Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,hcard] at hp
  have hX : 2*X.card=2^n := by dsimp [X]; omega
  have ht := tail_split A 1
  simp only [Nat.reduceAdd] at ht
  omega

theorem sum_free_tail_two {n : ℕ} (hcard : Nat.card G = 2^n) (hn : 2≤n) (A : Set G)
    (h : ∀ u v, u∈powerSubgroup G 1 → v∈powerSubgroup G 1 →
      ¬ (u∈A ∧ v∈A ∧ u+v∈A)) : 8*tailCount A 2 ≤ 2^n := by
  let H := powerSubgroup G 2
  let S : Finset H := {x | x.val∈A}
  have hs : ∀ u∈S, ∀ v∈S, u+v∉S := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    apply h u v (powerSubgroup_antitone 1 2 (by omega) u.property)
      (powerSubgroup_antitone 1 2 (by omega) v.property)
    exact ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).2,(Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2,
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp huv).2⟩
  have hb := sum_free_half_finset S hs
  have hc : S.card=tailCount A 2 := subtype_count A H
  rw [hc,←Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,power_subgroup_card hcard hn] at hb
  have hp : 2^n=4*2^(n-2) := by
    change 2^n=2^2*2^(n-2)
    rw [←pow_add,Nat.add_sub_of_le hn]
  omega

#print axioms diagonal_count
#print axioms no_double_count
#print axioms sum_free_tail_two
end LongWagner
```

### `CubeLWStatement.lean`

```lean
import CubeGroupTools
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Powerset

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option maxRecDepth 100000
namespace LongWagner

def CubeFree3 {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (A : Finset G) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y z : G, ¬ (x ∈ A ∧ y ∈ A ∧ z ∈ A ∧
    x+y ∈ A ∧ x+z ∈ A ∧ y+z ∈ A ∧ x+y+z ∈ A)

theorem cubeFree3_iff {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (A : Finset G) :
    CubeFree3 A ↔ CubeChecker.CubeFree (A : Set G) := Iff.rfl

def UpperStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Finset (ZMod (2^n))), CubeFree3 A → 8*A.card ≤ 5*2^n

def ConjectureStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ), 3 ≤ n →
    IsGreatest {k | ∃ A : Finset (ZMod (2^n)), CubeFree3 A ∧ A.card = k}
      (5 * 2^(n-3))

theorem extremizer_three :
    CubeFree3 CubeChecker.mod8Extremizer ∧ CubeChecker.mod8Extremizer.card = 5 :=
  ⟨CubeChecker.mod8_extremizer_cube_free, CubeChecker.mod8_extremizer_card⟩

def extremizerFour : Finset (ZMod 16) := {1,3,4,5,7,9,11,12,13,15}

theorem extremizer_four : CubeFree3 extremizerFour ∧ extremizerFour.card = 10 := by
  unfold CubeFree3
  decide +kernel

#print axioms extremizer_three
#print axioms extremizer_four
end LongWagner
```

### `CubeLWSharpness.lean`

```lean
import CubeLWStatement
import CubeLayerCounts
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace LongWagner
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def reductionEight (n : ℕ) (hn : 3≤n) : ZMod (2^n) →+* ZMod 8 :=
  ZMod.castHom (show 8 ∣ 2^n from CubeDyadic.twoPow_dvd hn) (ZMod 8)

def extremizer (n : ℕ) (hn : 3≤n) : Finset (ZMod (2^n)) :=
  {x | reductionEight n hn x ∈ CubeChecker.mod8Extremizer}

theorem extremizer_cube_free (n : ℕ) (hn : 3≤n) :
    CubeFree3 (extremizer n hn) := by
  apply (cubeFree3_iff _).mpr
  convert CubeChecker.cube_free_preimage (reductionEight n hn).toAddMonoidHom
    CubeChecker.mod8_extremizer_cube_free using 1
  ext x
  simp [extremizer]

theorem extremizer_card (n : ℕ) (hn : 3≤n) :
    (extremizer n hn).card = 5 * 2^(n-3) := by
  let f := (reductionEight n hn).toAddMonoidHom
  have hs : Function.Surjective f := ZMod.castHom_surjective (show 8 ∣ 2^n from CubeDyadic.twoPow_dvd hn)
  let q := ({x : ZMod (2^n) | f x=0} : Finset (ZMod (2^n))).card
  have hf (y : ZMod 8) :
      ({x : ZMod (2^n) | f x=y} : Finset (ZMod (2^n))).card = q := by
    exact AddMonoidHom.card_fiber_eq_of_mem_range f (hs y) (hs 0)
  have hall := CubeDyadic.uniform_preimage_card
    (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (2^n))) (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 8)) f q
    (by simp) (by simpa using hf) (Set.univ : Set (ZMod 8))
  have hq : q*8=2^n := by
    simpa using hall.symm
  have hp : 2^n=8*2^(n-3) := by
    change 2^n=2^3*2^(n-3)
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hn]
  have hq' : q=2^(n-3) := by omega
  have he := CubeDyadic.uniform_preimage_card
    (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (2^n))) (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 8)) f q
    (by simp) (by simpa using hf) (CubeChecker.mod8Extremizer : Set (ZMod 8))
  simpa [extremizer, f, hq', Nat.mul_comm, CubeChecker.mod8_extremizer_card] using he


#print axioms extremizer_cube_free
#print axioms extremizer_card
end LongWagner
```

### `CubeLWAssembly.lean`

```lean
import CubeLWCertifiedProfile
import CubeLWSharpness

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace LongWagner

/-- Conditional literal endpoint: the only mathematical input is HighOddBound. -/
theorem lw_upper_of_high_odd (high : HighOddBound) (n : ℕ)
    (A : Finset (ZMod (2^n))) (hA : CubeFree3 A) : 8*A.card ≤ 5*2^n := by
  have hc : Nat.card (ZMod (2^n))=2^n := by simp
  have hb := cyclic_upper_of_high_odd high n (ZMod (2^n)) hc (A : Set (ZMod (2^n))) ((cubeFree3_iff A).mp hA)
  simpa [totalCount] using hb

theorem lw_conj_5_1_of_high_odd (high : HighOddBound) (n : ℕ) (hn : 3≤n) :
    IsGreatest {k | ∃ A : Finset (ZMod (2^n)), CubeFree3 A ∧ A.card=k}
      (5*2^(n-3)) := by
  refine ⟨⟨extremizer n hn,extremizer_cube_free n hn,extremizer_card n hn⟩,?_⟩
  rintro k ⟨A,hA,hcard⟩
  have hb := lw_upper_of_high_odd high n A hA
  have hp : 2^n=8*2^(n-3) := by
    change 2^n=2^3*2^(n-3)
    rw [←pow_add,Nat.add_sub_of_le hn]
  rw [hcard] at hb
  rw [hp] at hb
  omega

#print axioms lw_upper_of_high_odd
#print axioms lw_conj_5_1_of_high_odd
end LongWagner
```

### `CubeLWHighBranch.lean`

```lean
import CubeLWHighCounts
import CubeIntegerProfile

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace LongWagner
open CubeChecker CubeDyadic
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

lemma totalCount_le_card_sub_one {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G]
    [DecidableEq G] (A : Set G) (hA : CubeFree A) :
    totalCount A ≤ Nat.card G - 1 := by
  have hs : ({x : G | x∈A} : Finset G) ⊆ Finset.univ.erase 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have ha : x∈A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
    have hz : x≠0 := by intro he; exact zero_excluded hA (he ▸ ha)
    simp [hz]
  simpa [totalCount,←Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using Finset.card_le_card hs

theorem high_odd_bound : HighOddBound := by
  intro n G _ _ _ _ hcard A hA hc
  by_cases hn : 2≤n
  · have hd := diagonal_count hcard hn A hA
    by_cases hcap : 8*layerCount A 0 ≤ 3*2^n
    · have hno := high_odd_no_double hcard (show 1≤n by omega) A hA hc
      have he := no_double_count hcard hn A hno
      have ht := tail_split A 0
      rw [tail_zero] at ht
      exact CubeIntegerProfile.high_odd_middle (2^n) (layerCount A 0)
        (layerCount A 1) (tailCount A 1) (totalCount A) ht hd he hcap
    · have hsum := high_odd_even_sum_free hcard (show 1≤n by omega) A hA (by omega)
      have hb := sum_free_tail_two hcard hn A hsum
      have h0 := tail_split A 0
      have h1 := tail_split A 1
      rw [tail_zero] at h0
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd] at h0 h1
      exact CubeIntegerProfile.high_odd_upper (2^n) (layerCount A 0)
        (layerCount A 1) (tailCount A 2) (totalCount A) (by omega) hd hb
  · have hb := totalCount_le_card_sub_one A hA
    rw [hcard] at hb
    interval_cases n <;> norm_num at hb ⊢ <;> omega

#print axioms high_odd_bound
end LongWagner
```
